sections.indications_and_usage: Uses Relieves: Heartburn Acid indigestion Sour stomach Upset stomach due to these symptoms
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions Find the right dose on chart below based on weight, otherwise use age. Pour powder into cup and add 15mg (0.51 oz.) of water, stir and drink. Dosing Chart Weight (lbs) Age Dose Under 24 Under 2 yrs Ask a doctor 24-47 2-5 yrs 1/2 pouch 48-95 6-11 yrs 1 pouch
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. When using this product: do not take more than 1 pouch in a 24 hour period. use open pouch within two weeks.
